item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Ready for today? Here's your weather for Friday, October 23. It's Friday. The weekend is very nearly here! Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be on and off showers. The high will be 23 degrees, and the low will be 17 degrees. Pleasantly warm today, perfect for being outdoors. Rain is about 100 percent likely today. It's a blowy one out there today. Here's something to notice: today is about 2 degrees warmer than yesterday. Do you think you can feel it? Don't forget your umbrella today! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be on and off showers, reaching 22 degrees. Keep getting dark early in mind today. That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
